PayPal Holdings and Nexi have expanded their partnership to integrate PayPal’s payment ecosystem into Nexi’s merchant platform across Europe. The agreement deepens PayPal’s presence with European merchants by making its digital wallet and checkout options more readily available within Nexi’s infrastructure.
